gloss: chapters and verses; passages; phrases from a text

definitions.gloss: chapters and verses; passages from a text
definitions.explanation: Sections or passages of a written work, especially of classical texts, scriptures, or literary works. Often refers to the act of studying texts passage by passage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{聖書|せいしょ}→聖書：17969_seisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{章句|しょうく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引用|いんよう}する→引用する：26928_inyousuru⟧。
examples.english: To quote a passage from the Bible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{章句|しょうく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: Memorizing passages from the classics is difficult.

examples.japanese: {論語|ろんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{章句|しょうく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親|した}しまれている→親しむ：14139_shitashimu⟧。
examples.english: Famous passages from the Analects of Confucius are still enjoyed by many people today.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧ (chapter) + ⟦{句|く}→句：02137_ku⟧ (phrase, verse). A somewhat literary term used when referring to passages from classical, religious, or important texts. In classical Chinese studies (⟦{漢学|かんがく}→漢学：24281_kangaku⟧), {章句|しょうく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ referred to the meticulous study of texts line by line.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {章句|しょうく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to cite a passage
- {章句|しょうく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暗唱|あんしょう}する→暗唱する：26776_anshousuru⟧: to recite passages from memory
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{章句|しょうく}: a famous passage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{節|せつ}→節：19359_setsu⟧: section, verse -- a division of a text, less literary
- {一節|いっせつ}: a passage, a section -- refers to one specific part
- ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧: phrase, words -- in modern usage usually means complaint, but originally meant a phrase of text
- ⟦{引用|いんよう}→引用：01850_inyou⟧: quotation, citation -- the act of quoting rather than the passage itself
